description: This PHP source file defines a migration class for version 5.3.0 of the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods for updating database schemas, converting timestamps to UTC, removing legacy tables and columns, and managing internationalization strings. The class extends AbstractMigration and interacts with database schemas, foreign keys, and configuration values relevant to the migration process.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Represents a database migration for version 5.3.0 of OrangeHRM, responsible for schema updates, timestamp conversions, foreign key management, and language string updates.

methods.description: Performs the migration steps, including permission insertion, language string updates, schema modifications, timestamp conversions, and cleanup tasks.

methods.description: Returns the version identifier for this migration ('5.3.0').

methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the LangStringHelper instance used for language string operations.
